data.title: Cyclone Arnab: red alert Oct 28 for Mulugu, Kothagudem, Khammam; Hyderabad no alert
data.body: The system should become a severe cyclonic storm by Oct 27 and cross Andhra on Oct 28. Telangana: 3 red, 5 orange and 8 yellow districts. Hyderabad city: light rain or thundershowers, no alert.

steps.b: Depression formed; severe cyclone expected by Oct 27, Andhra crossing Oct 28.
East and northeast Telangana get heavy to very heavy rain on Oct 28.
Private forecaster T Balaji sees light-moderate Hyderabad rain Oct 29–Nov 4.

data.care: Travel to Khammam or Bhadrachalam on Oct 27–28? Push it if you can.

data.body: MEMU 66571/66572 off Oct 23–25, Oct 28–Nov 1, Nov 4–7 for Tumakuru yard work; some expresses delayed. Plan buses or other trains.
